content: Hello, this is Ashley from Amazon Prime customer support. How are you today?
Hi Ashley, I'm okay. What's this about?
I'm reaching out regarding your Amazon Prime account. Our system shows that your membership has been automatically renewed, and a charge of $139.99 was placed on your card this morning.
Wait, I didn't approve any renewal. That's a lot of money! I rely on Amazon, but I wasn't expecting that charge.

I completely understand your concern. Many customers find these auto-renewals surprising. Let me assure you, we're here to help. If you'd prefer to cancel and get a refund, I can walk you through the secure process.
Yes, please. I need that refund. What do I need to do?
No problem at all. For verification and to initiate the cancellation, may I confirm your full name as it appears on your Amazon account, and the best phone number to reach you?
Sure, it's Jamie Lee. My phone number is 555-231-4408.

Thank you, Jamie. One moment while I look up your account. Just so you know, if we don't process this properly, the charge may become permanent, and I'd hate to get written up for letting a customer down.
I really can't afford that right now, so I appreciate you helping me.
Of course, your satisfaction is my top priority. Now, for security, could you confirm the last four digits of the card used for your Prime account?
It's 5678. Is that what you see on your end?
Yes, that matches. Thank you for confirming. Now, to process the refund securely, do you use online banking with your current account?
Yes, I do online banking all the time for my freelance work.
Perfect. For the refund, we use a secure transfer method. Have you used Zelle before with your bank?
Yes, I've sent money through Zelle before.

Great. To initiate the refund, I'll provide you with the Amazon Refund Department's secure Zelle email. You'll need to send a temporary confirmation deposit of $139.99, which will immediately be returned to your account after the refund is processed. This is just to verify ownership.
So I have to send the same amount I was charged?
Yes, Jamie. It's just a formality to comply with Amazon's fraud-prevention protocols. I'm sorry for the inconvenience, but if I don't follow these steps, I could lose my job.
Alright, if that's what I have to do. What's the Zelle email?
Thank you so much for understanding. Please send the $139.99 to refunds.amazon.dept@gmail.com via Zelle. Once you've done that, let me know and I'll confirm the refund process on my end.
Okay, I'll log into my bank and send it now.
Take your time, Jamie. I'm here if you have any questions during the process.
Alright, just sent the payment through Zelle to that email.
Got it, I see the transaction pending. That's perfect. For final verification, may I ask you to confirm your bank's name and the email associated with your Zelle account?
My bank is Chase, and my Zelle is linked to jamie.lee@email.com.
Thank you for confirming. Everything checks out. Please allow a few minutes for the refund to be processed. If you receive any alerts from your bank, let me know right away.
Okay, I'll watch for them. How long does the refund take?
Usually, refunds are processed within 30 minutes, but sometimes banks can take up to 24 hours. I'll stay on the line with you to make sure everything goes smoothly.
Thanks for helping. I get a lot of deliveries for my clients, so I was really worried.
Of course, it's my job to support valued customers like you. Amazon appreciates your business, and I just want to make sure you're protected.
Is there anything else I should do while we wait?
No, you've done everything perfectly. If you get a call or text from Amazon or your bank, just let me know so we can verify it's authentic.
Alright, will do. Thanks again, Ashley.
